title: Outdoor Gear Box Gold Standard
text:
I honestly found all of the gear in the 4 boxes I received high quality and useful. Shipping was quick and everything arrived well packaged. My only complaint is one of my boxes was substituted for another box from a previous month of lesser value than the one it replaced. The substitution wasn't really is issue, however I expect an equal or above value substitution. The box sent after that had an item that went along with the box that I did not get, making that one not as useful either.

All in all it's work checking out for a month or two. I am currently weighing my options with other boxes to see how they compare.
label: neutral
